splash.notice: Character changes in this game are fantasy effects driven by game EXP and do not represent real product results. In-game items are virtual and separate from real products.
intro.1.title: You meet a tiny, lovable friend
intro.1.body: One day, an adorable guest wanders into a small, newly opened MEDIDERMA lounge.
intro.2.title: UNI&CORE products and DERMA HOME
intro.2.body: UNI&CORE products line the shelves, and the DERMA HOME device — RF, Ultrasonic and Iontophoresis — waits in the care zone.
intro.3.title: Growth comes from your care
intro.3.body: Complete care missions and earn EXP to see your character evolve through five stages — through your touch, not a timer.
intro.4.title: Grow a lounge of your own
intro.4.body: Welcome customers, decorate your space and share on the Beauty Feed — until your mini lounge becomes a global flagship!
create.title: Meet your character
create.desc: Give a name and pick a first look. You can change it any time.
create.name: Name
create.rotate: Drag to rotate 360° · wheel / pinch to zoom
create.diversity: No skin tone or feature ranks above another — every choice is simply your style.
hud.hint: WASD / arrows to move · click floor to walk · drag to rotate · wheel to zoom · E to interact
visit.title: Visiting {name}'s lounge
visit.demo: A sample lounge of a demo friend
edit.title: Edit interior
edit.hintMove: Tap the floor to move the selected piece there.
edit.hintSelect: Tap a piece to select it, or place one from storage below.
edit.empty: No furniture in storage. Visit the Interior Shop.
photo.title: Character Photo
photo.hint: Drag to frame the shot, pick a pose, then shoot.
photo.caption: Add a caption
care.pickDesc: Shortened missions based on the official DERMA HOME routines. In each step apply the listed product, pick an area and stroke it with the device.
care.needProduct: You have none in stock. Buy here or visit the Item Shop.
care.mistDesc: Official face routines end with a mist. Finishing earns bonus EXP.
care.fantasy: Character changes are fantasy effects driven by game EXP.
char.rotate: Drag the scene to view your character in 360°.
lounge.lpHint: Earn LOUNGE POINT by caring for customers.
shop.virtual: Purchases here are virtual in-game items, not real orders. Rarity is a collection grade, not a ranking of product quality or efficacy.
shop.mall: See real products on the official mall
shop.stored: Added to storage. Place it in Edit Interior.
codex.unverifiedDesc: Ingredients and directions have not been collected yet. Please check the official product page.
codex.disclaimer: In-game effects are unrelated to real product efficacy. For real use, follow the product manual and official guide.
social.demo: This is an in-game SNS that runs only on your device for now. Accounts and posts marked DEMO are samples, not real users.
social.phase: Real-time friends, chat, gifting and global rankings arrive with the server in Phases 4–5.
growth.note: Growth is never automatic. When EXP from care, customers, social, fashion and lounge activities reaches a stage threshold, the evolution scene begins.
cust.none: No customers right now. Someone will drop by soon!
cust.noRegulars: Guests who rate 4 or more become regulars.
cust.fiction: All customers are fictional game characters.
consult.express: Customer care runs as an express (2-step) session. ✔/✕ shows whether the lounge has the product in stock.
consult.ok: Hmm… I'll give it a try.
set.langNote: Korean and English are fully translated; other languages are a beta covering core UI. Official product names are not translated.
set.controlsBody:
PC: WASD / arrows to move · click floor to walk · drag to rotate · wheel to zoom · E / Space to interact
Mobile: left joystick or tap the floor to move · one-finger drag to rotate · two-finger pinch to zoom
set.saveFail: Browser storage is unavailable; progress lasts this session only.
set.resetAsk: All progress will be deleted. Continue?
